Overview

Piura is a city in PI with a population of 500,000. A hot northern city near the Ecuador border, known for its cotton production and warm beaches. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
